title: H2 file-list items must be markdown links

spec.name: llms.txt (llmstxt.org)
spec.normative_quote: Zero or more markdown sections (h2) delimited by an H2 headers, containing a list of URLs that provide additional context... each link SHOULD be in the form: - [name](url): notes.
spec.note: conformance_testable is false -- llmstxt.org itself is descriptive/indexing, not conformance-tested. Recalled from training-data familiarity with the public page, not re-verified against a live fetch this session.

applicability: An H2 section's list item (a line matching /^[-*]\s+/) once at least one H2 has been seen.

cases.name: a bare-URL list item, not a markdown link
